title: An import update onto COD saves a $0 limit and the row is not refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A exists on Net 30 with a credit limit of $800.00.
  • Have a contacts import file that updates customer A with the credit term "COD" and the credit limit 800.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • Credit Terms reads COD and Credit Limit shows $0.00, disabled.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R8: “A customer created or updated through the Public API, or updated by the contacts import, onto COD or Credit Hold is saved with a $0 credit limit, whatever limit was sent; the request or row is not refused (S10-N1). A Public API update that sends neither a credit term nor a credit limit leaves the stored limit as it is.”
  • S10-N1: “Imports and the Public API never refuse a row or a request because of its credit term.”
